ShayBox's Lighthouse 2.1.0 C library (https://github.com/ShayBox/Lighthouse), shipped prebuilt
with the packages for the overlay's Lighthouse 2.0 channel changes over Bluetooth LE
(scripts/fetch-lighthouse-ble.py pins the release files by SHA-256). MIT; its main dependencies
are tokio (MIT) and btleplug (MIT / Apache-2.0 / BSD-3-Clause). The texts are here and go into
every package's license folder.
